components.name: mcore-bridge
components.changes: MARCH memory-anchor training and Safin-1 checkpoint conversion. Retains optimized/reference FlashQLA backward, sparse top-k routing and persistent state; removes unreleased dense self-attention replacement, state-output injection, Direct-A/native/split backward selection and dense Tile global read. Reject unimplemented history-mixing/momentum settings before training; remove retired query-adapter conversion/sharding, isolated projection helpers and constant branch remnants while retaining inactive default metadata and active parameter names. Derive MARCH training from model config; reject runtime/architecture environment conflicts; preflight complete Safin weights before copies, retaining base-Qwen initialization, ordinary LoRA and new persistent-state zero initialization. Gate upstream model-download tests and preserve assigned GPUs. Standalone MARCH projection adapters now export selected LoRA A/B tensors and modules_to_save via the generic PEFT converter; reject unsupported trainable raw-state adapter exports rather than silently dropping them.

provenance_verification.method: exact original import Git tree match

components.name: vLLM
components.changes: Safin-1 dense/MoE registry, MARCH prefill/decode, history caching and kernel dispatch. Removed OLMo3 model/config registrations, dedicated serving guards, tool/reasoning parsers, tests and documentation; retained Safin-1 Graph defaults and shared kernels. Removed low-rank history storage/kernels and compression budget/telemetry; retained dense Graph/eager paths, persistent-memory state and Graph sidecars. Removed inactive opaque/fixed-op/MoE, forced FlashAttention schedule/split and FP32 TP probes; Experimental eager/Graph V3 prefix reuse now uses complete runtime identities, epochs/generations, fixed state/history storage, canonical single-request prefill partitions with concurrent Graph decode and coordinated reset at drained weight updates. Mutable persistent-memory/prefix reuse remains unsupported; diagnostic tracing is retained for acceptance. Extract unchanged anchor layouts, shared runtime predicates and optional diagnostics into model helpers; preserve original exports and model classes, reject removed compression options, and remove retired constant branches without changing active kernels or serving defaults. Prefill extraction separates single-request dispatch, segments parity, packed prefill and paged-prefill reads; ten lazy backend loaders share one cache owner. Arithmetic, persistent state, native kernels and serving defaults remain unchanged. Decode extraction separates unchanged single-request cached recurrence, projection/admission and Graph V3 execution into constructor-free helpers; retains batched routing, state ownership, native kernels and defaults. Batched decode extraction separates admission/restoration, local GDN, anchor append, no-anchor completion and reference/padding finalization with typed per-forward state contracts. Preserves ordered statements, original False/None behavior, parameter/cache ownership and defaults; current-source GPU validation is tracked separately. Distribution cleanup omits upstream CI and large binary/generated documentation assets; runtime/native-build/test source is retained and documentation assets link to the pinned upstream revision.
